categories.main_business_segments: Samil Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in pharmaceutical manufacturing and sales, focusing on prescription drugs specialized in ophthalmology, liver diseases, and gastrointestinal treatments. The company also engages in the import and exclusive domestic sales of original drugs. Its business is divided into pharmaceutical products and other segments, with pharmaceuticals accounting for 97.3% of 2023 sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies including drug formulation improvements, drug delivery systems (DDS), and biological equivalence studies. It operates cGMP and EU-GMP compliant production facilities, including a global ophthalmic CMO plant in Vietnam. R&D focuses on new drug development, generic drugs, and improved formulations, supported by a central research institute with 19 researchers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Samil Pharmaceutical serves hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and consumers primarily in South Korea. Its products target therapeutic areas such as ophthalmology, central nervous system, gastrointestinal, and liver diseases. The company also supplies global pharmaceutical companies through its CMO services and has exclusive distribution agreements for imported drugs in Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing and sales activities. It has expanded internationally with a wholly owned subsidiary in Vietnam operating a global ophthalmic CMO plant and a North American subsidiary for pharmaceutical wholesale. Its license agreements cover the Korean market, and it imports and distributes foreign pharmaceutical products domestically.
categories.supply_chain_position: Samil Pharmaceutical operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, including drug development, manufacturing, and distribution. It also acts as an exclusive importer and distributor for foreign pharmaceutical products in Korea. Its subsidiary provides contract manufacturing services (CMO) for ophthalmic drugs, serving upstream pharmaceutical companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes developing innovative drugs and improved formulations, with ongoing clinical trials for new treatments in non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) and osteoarthritis. It emphasizes partnerships and licensing agreements with global biotech firms for new drug commercialization in Korea. Investment in advanced manufacturing facilities and expanding CMO capabilities are key R&D and growth priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of pharmaceutical products, including both in-house developed drugs and licensed products. The company also earns income from exclusive distribution agreements for imported drugs and contract manufacturing services via its subsidiary. Additional revenue streams include service contracts and leasing, though these constitute a small portion of total sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Samil Pharmaceutical is positioned as a mid-sized, specialized pharmaceutical company in Korea, competing with larger domestic firms like Yuhan Corporation, Green Cross, and Hanmi Pharmaceutical. It differentiates through its focus on ophthalmology, CNS, and gastrointestinal drugs, as well as its growing CMO business. The company faces intense competition in generic drug markets but leverages licensing and innovation to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Samil Pharmaceutical reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 196.3 billion, reflecting a 9.3% year-over-year growth. The company achieved operating income of KRW 6.47 billion and net income of KRW 1.66 billion, marking a return to profitability. Total assets stood at KRW 370.7 billion with a moderate increase in liabilities and equity, supported by recent capital investments in manufacturing facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers specialized pharmaceutical products with a focus on original and improved drugs in niche therapeutic areas such as ophthalmology and liver diseases. Its value proposition includes high-quality manufacturing compliant with global GMP standards, exclusive licensing and distribution rights for innovative foreign drugs, and a growing contract manufacturing business that leverages cost advantages from its Vietnam facility. This combination supports differentiated product offerings and stable market presence.
